prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create one new character asset for the Petani farming app, 1000 x 1000 PNG with a genuinely transparent alpha background.
Input image 1 (planting) and image 2 (fertilizing) are STYLE AND CHARACTER references: closely match their hand-painted cartoon illustration style, warm shading, subtle paper-like painted texture, rounded outlines, proportions, rich green shirt, dark green trousers, navy rubber boots with brown soles, yellow gloves, tan straw hat with a green band, dark-rimmed protective glasses and white mask. Use this same friendly farmer character design and tone, not a 3D clay render and not monochrome.
Input image 3 is POSE reference only. Make the farmer lying comfortably on his back, his head supported on a soft cream pillow. He is awake and relaxed, looking at a small dark smartphone held naturally in both hands above his abdomen/chest. Both legs are visible, knees comfortably bent, one ankle crossed over the opposite knee in the relaxed figure-four resting pose shown in the pose reference. Two arms and two legs only, natural readable anatomy.
Important composition: show the FULL BODY from an elevated isometric three-quarter view. The head and pillow are at the UPPER LEFT (northwest) and feet point toward the LOWER RIGHT (southeast), with the body axis following that diagonal. Clearly show the crossed legs and boots pointing toward the bottom-right, never bottom-left. The head actually rests on the pillow, with the straw hat tilted back enough to allow the reclined position and eyes visible looking toward the phone.
Keep the farmer and pillow fully inside the square, centered balanced composition with 8-10% transparent margin. Match the crisp painted task illustrations and their warm green/yellow/navy palette and soft warm light. Only one farmer, one pillow and one smartphone, with a tiny soft semitransparent contact shadow. No plants, tools, floor slab, scenery, bed, text, logo, watermark, opaque background or checkerboard.
refinement: Refine this generated farmer illustration into a clean transparent app asset. Preserve the farmer character design, painted illustration style, exact clothing/colors, pillow, phone and relaxed crossed-leg pose. Remove ALL surrounding white/gray painted haze, floor, background wash and broad shadows completely: every pixel outside the farmer and pillow must be transparent alpha, with only a very small faint contact shadow directly under them. Reframe to fit the whole character and pillow within the central 80% of a 1000 x 1000 square, with clear transparent margins on all four sides. Use a slightly more elevated isometric camera so the head/pillow are upper-left and the boots project toward lower-right (southeast). Both legs must remain anatomically clear, one ankle crossed over the opposite knee, head resting on the pillow, hands holding the phone. Keep same warm detailed cartoon painting as source. No extra objects, text, checkerboard or opaque background.
